entries.title: drop the second prompt when uninstalling from the system dialog
entries.description: Uninstalling an app through the system dialog now asks for biometrics once instead of twice.

entries.title: resume install prompts as the app that requested them
entries.description: Installing an app now goes through on the first tap instead of needing a second one after the prompt.

entries.title: stop re-prompting when an installer asks for pre-approval
entries.description: Installing an app from a store that asks for confirmation up front no longer repeats the biometric prompt forever.

entries.title: block screen pinning from opening a locked app without auth
entries.description: Pinning a locked app from recents no longer opens it without authentication.

entries.title: add 3 and 10 minute re-lock delays plus a custom value
entries.description:
Custom delays are entered in minutes and apply to the global delay and to
per-app overrides.

entries.title: relock a locked app when the user goes home
entries.description:
Locked apps set to re-lock immediately now ask for the prompt again after
you leave them for the home screen, not only after another app opens.

entries.title: send a locked app home when the unlock prompt cannot start
entries.description: Locked apps no longer open without authentication in the seconds after a reboot, when the prompt cannot be shown yet.

entries.title: redact the lockscreen copy of a locked app notification
entries.description: Notifications from a locked app no longer reveal their content on the lockscreen when Android is set to hide sensitive content.

entries.title: hide notification content while an app is locked
entries.description: Notifications posted by a locked app now show a placeholder instead of their title and text until the app is unlocked.

entries.title: resume apps with no startable activity after unlock
entries.description: Unlocking an app that has no launchable entry now opens it instead of returning to the home screen.

entries.title: show apps without a launcher activity in the app list
entries.description: Iconless packages like Shell now appear in the app list and stay visible on the dashboard while locked.
